coverage.finding: The ink page label '62b.' sits at the top left. The b is superscript and is followed by a dot. The transcription is correct.

The two-line ink entry and its lighter pressmark are confirmed. The leftward arrow at canvas x≈3024–3129 lies left of the gutter (x≈3200), so it is on the target page. The readings 'hō/no', 'ends in [amutbhava?]' and 'Owner' remain uncertain, as the candidate already marks them.
The faint pencil line is confirmed, with its tick, 'Begins:', the incipit and the closing parenthesis. A small superscript mark stands over '10'. The first word of the incipit remains uncertain.

The two pencil lines are confirmed. The arrow treated as part of this block is at canvas x≈3274–3354. That is right of the gutter line (x≈3200), so the arrow is in the left margin of fol. 63 beside 'q' and c.372(4). It is not target-page writing. The words in the middle of line 1 look like '[of a different?] ritual work & third' rather than the candidate's bracketed guess.
The ink note 'ff.1-17, S.1730' is confirmed, followed by a leftward arrow left of the gutter. The dash beyond it, at x≈3214–3334, is on fol. 63.
